title: Temporary State Variable Bloat
pattern: Creating a cascade of intermediate temporary variables to pass state between contiguous code blocks in a single long function.
why_bad: Temp clutter limits extraction. Makes it difficult to partition logic because variables couple contiguous statements together.
detection: Long methods containing many localized variables whose scopes overlap sequentially.
counterexample: Well-commented mathematical algorithms where variables explain the intermediate calculations of a single formula.
source: Martin Fowler, *Refactoring*, "Replace Temp with Query"; Robert C. Martin, *Clean Code*.
